title: Medieval Manuscripts Database
description: Schema for cataloging medieval manuscript collections

library.description: Name of the library or institution

nation.description: Country where the library is located

city.description: City where the library is located

website.description: URL to the library's manuscript collection; must use HTTP or HTTPS

quantity.description: Approximate number of digitized medieval manuscripts

iiif.description: Whether the collection supports IIIF (International Image Interoperability Framework)

is_free_cultural_works_license.description: Whether the collection uses a Creative Commons free cultural works license

aggregators.description: Aggregator projects or websites this collection is discoverable through, if any. Use an empty array for a collection with no aggregator membership.

name.description: Name of the aggregator project or website

url.description: Canonical home page of the aggregator; must use HTTP or HTTPS

is_disabled.description: Whether the collection URL has been confirmed unreachable. Optional: omit it for a collection whose link is believed to work.

last_checked.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the collection URL was last checked. Required when is_disabled is true, so a warning shown to a reader can always be dated.
